_: The pinned python-build-standalone release the bundled CAD runtime is built from
(scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs). One asset per packaged target, `install_only` flavour;
the sha256 is the release's SHA256SUMS entry for that file and every download is
checked against it before extraction. `pip.platforms` are the wheel platform tags pip
resolves the target's dependency closure with (`pip install --platform`): pip expands a
macOS tag to the versions below it, but a `manylinux_X_Y` tag is matched exactly, so
Linux lists every tag the closure's wheels carry (cadquery-ocp is manylinux_2_31;
shapely and vtk are manylinux2014/manylinux_2_17). The macOS tag is the HIGHEST
minimum in the closure, and therefore the oldest macOS the runtime runs on: 12.0 on
3.13 because cadgen's wheels (cadquery-ocp, build123d) ship for it and the constraints
file scripts/cad-resources.mjs freezes comes from a 3.13 venv, so the bundled runtime
and the development runtime resolve the same closure.
